scope: Ex-ante BoJ reaction-function replay specification for JPY. This file freezes the rules before observing replay outcomes.

engine.scale: median absolute first differences, last 80 observations

wages.metric: scheduled cash earnings YoY from MHLW preliminary releases
wages.pit_requirement: contemporaneous preliminary release only; document URL and checksum required

inflation.block_aggregation: median of available component impulses at each checkpoint
inflation.pit_requirement: contemporaneous first-release national CPI report only; no current/rebased historical fallback; document URL and checksum required
inflation.base_change_policy: preserve contemporaneous published base; do not retroactively rebase first-release observations

fx.benchmark: JPY versus equal-weight basket of the other seven G8 currencies
fx.entry_policy: first ECB daily reference observation strictly after reaction-state checkpoint

rates_optional.rule: Rates/front-end/yield differential may classify transmission state only. It must not filter, include, exclude, or reweight reaction-function events.

state_construction.series_impulse: same frozen-style normalized impulse used elsewhere in PIT research: latest first difference divided by median absolute first differences over the latest 80 eligible observations; minimum 8 observations
state_construction.inflation_state: direction of median normalized impulse across headline and core CPI
state_construction.event_universe: All chronological checkpoints where either wages or CPI state updates and both blocks have at least the frozen minimum history. No post-hoc event deletion.
state_construction.directional_test_universe: Only checkpoints with predeclared jpy_polarity +1 or -1; mixed/neutral states remain in evidence but cast no directional vote.

evaluation.rates_attribution: If an eligible official front-end/yield-differential history exists, compare ALIGNED vs CONFLICT vs FLAT within identical macro-state cohorts and identical FX timing. No binary confirmation rule.

comparison_baseline.purpose: Compare BoJ reaction-function replay against the already-failed direct Growth+Labour JPY replay without changing the frozen baseline.

guardrails: No tuning of thresholds, weights, horizons, event windows, or state definitions after viewing results
No production promotion from full-sample results alone
Walk-forward must use exact chronological event cohorts
Rates are explanatory transmission state, never a mandatory confirmation filter

required_before_execution: document URL and checksum present for every certified observation
exact local file paths identified on the execution branch
